positive_law: The whole image is built from accumulated physical-looking marks and deposits whose overlap, interruption and persistence carry both people and circumstance. Human presence is authored through recurring individual mark signatures and bodily rhythm rather than clean contour drawing. Earlier action remains visible as altered or retained mark history in the present field.

axes.representation ontology: accumulated indexical-looking marks and deposits; image reads as a field of retained acts rather than objects assembled from clean shapes
axes.spatial/relational organization: layered overlap, interruption and partial occlusion establish proximity and relationship without connective graphics
axes.figure-ground/material-edge grammar: fibrous, broken, pressure-varied edges; figure and ground interpenetrate through deposits and erased/covered passages
axes.human identity/specificity mechanism: each person has a repeatable mark-density, gesture-rhythm and proportion signature that remains distinct through partial representation
axes.consequence/history representation: prior human action persists as changed accumulation, overwrite, abrasion, residue or displaced mark density in the present surface
axes.tonal/texture/atmosphere construction: tactile near-monochrome field driven by density, pressure and surface grain rather than smooth lighting or decorative color

anti_motif: Do not reduce the premise to one footprint, stain, scar, trail or decorative brush effect; the entire image must obey the accumulated-mark ontology.
expected_failure_modes: generic painterly illustration with ordinary scene underneath
residue becomes one symbolic clue instead of whole-surface grammar
construction_exclusions: current C0/O3/TYP/MAT/STA/MOT/CLR mechanisms as construction ingredients
historical exact VID/hero/Quiet Stage/Mineral Theater surfaces
brand marks, names, UI, wordmark, bespoke typography, product semantics, functional iconography, motion scoring, final palette selection
renderer_translation_law: Translate only the positive whole-surface premise law and the applicable neutral content packet into renderer-visible prose. Do not include this premise's expected failure modes, contamination notes, project vocabulary or comparison criteria.
